question: The Government of India aims to provide affordable housing to urban residents by 2022 through the ____ programme, which was first introduced on 25 June 2015.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) scheme was launched on 25th June, 2015. The primary aim for this Yojana is to ensure that 2 crore houses are built across nation’s length and breadth.**

 
• PMAY in MIG is extended until March 31st, 2021.

 
• Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana

 
• Launched on: 25th June 2015.
 
• Aim: to provide housing for all in Urban Areas by the year 2022.
 
• The mission provides Central Assistance to the implementing agencies through State/Union Territories (UTs) and Central Nodal Agencies for providing houses to all eligible families against the validated demand for houses for about 1.12 crores.
 
• The house for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) could be up to 30 sq. mt. carpet area but the state/UTs have the flexibility to enhance the size of houses.

 
• Union Minister of Housing and Urban Affairs - Hardeep Singh Puri (constituency - Uttar Pradesh)
